paragraphs.text: Xyrun-Jed was a loxodon during Asterion 's on Arcavios . He was the last emperor of the loxodon.

Xyrun-Jed is suggested to be a majestic and significant figure in loxodon history on Arcavios , as indicated by the enormous golden statue likely representing him. The statue is laden with gemstones and jade, suggesting that Xyrun-Jed was depicted grandly and nobly, fitting for an emperor. This opulence hints at his esteemed status and the reverence in which he was held by his people.

As the last loxodon emperor, Xyrun-Jed displayed qualities of wisdom, leadership, and sacrifice. Faced with the destruction of his city, he chose to see it fall rather than have it plundered and overtaken, showing a strong sense of duty and protection towards his people and their legacy. This act portrays him as a determined and resolute leader, willing to make difficult decisions for the greater good. The Canticle of Jed used as a prayer and meditation in times of distress, also suggests that Xyrun-Jed was a spiritual and philosophical figure, whose words provided guidance and solace to the loxodon in dire circumstances.

Xyrun-Jed's history is intertwined with the legend of Zantafar, the famed lost city of the loxodon . He was the last emperor during a time of great turmoil and betrayal, leading to the fall of the city. Different versions of the legend attribute the fall to various causes, including an earthquake sent by ancient gods, a spectral army of loxodon ancestors, or Xyrun-Jed himself using magic to seal the city away. Regardless of the version, Xyrun-Jed’s actions resulted in the dispersion of the loxodon across the Vastlands. His authorship of the Canticle of Jed, a piece of enduring loxodon culture, further cements his legacy as a significant historical and cultural figure. His decision to hide the city from its enemies rather than let it be conquered shows his strategic thinking and deep care for his people’s heritage.
